Numerical independence should be explicitly proved, rather than left inside the wellposedness claim.
Vertical negativity is the Hodge input; metric monotonicity itself uses effectivity and positive restrictions.
The mixed n=1 pairing has second derivative twice the mixed vertical intersection.
The n=0 first-variation case is affine and should avoid a negative number of slots.
Class-change finiteness can be proved with the exact published two-sided Lemma 7.9 estimate.
Before finite polarization, nef-boundary mixed terms must be handled on PL data and then by limits.
The vector space is made from finite-energy restrictions, not the psh cone itself.
Locality uses the crossing lemma on every component meeting the chosen component.
Weighted convergence needs ample backgrounds, finite-energy limiting measure slots and integrable limiting test.
Fixed-class regularization and foundational energy extension do not consume EP.
The irrational-corner/divisorial sentence was suspected but retained after checking the rational-scale definition in Chapter 32.
Each curve endpoint is null via a finite-energy pole witness, rather than an unsupported uncountable union.

Toric translation by e decreases the conjugate integral by e times the polytope volume.
